metadata.summary: VinDr-CXR is a large chest X-ray dataset of 18,000 posteroanterior (PA) radiographs from 18,000 patients, collected at two hospitals in Vietnam. It provides 22 localized bounding-box annotations for findings plus 6 global (image-level) labels.
metadata.purpose: Used for lesion detection and image-level classification benchmarks.

papers.title: VinDr-CXR: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Chest X-ray Abnormality Detection

ethics.legal_compliance: Complies with PhysioNet Open Data policy.

known_limitations: Test labels are consensus (limited individual-rater variance)
bias_sources: consensus labeling reduces inter-rater variability in test set
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: Limited to two centers in Vietnam; lacks geographic, demographic, and technical diversity.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Generalizability may be limited to adult PA chest X-rays in similar healthcare settings; not validated on lateral views or non-Vietnamese populations.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: No explicit reporting on sex, age, or ethnicity subgroups.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: No information provided on missingness of clinical metadata or imaging quality.

tasks_and_use.excluded_tasks: Tasks requiring lateral views, pediatric populations, or fine-grained temporal follow-up.

data_origin.selection_rationale: 18,000 posteroanterior (PA) radiographs from 18,000 patients, collected at two hospitals in Vietnam.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: All images are PA view; no lateral views included.

population.inclusion_criteria: Posteroanterior chest X-rays from patients at two hospitals in Vietnam.
population.exclusion_criteria: Lateral views; non-chest X-rays; pediatric or non-adult cases (implied by 'adult chest findings scoped').
population.missing_groups: Pediatric, pregnancy, elderly subgroups not explicitly reported or confirmed; lateral-view absence limits anatomical completeness.

annotation.annotation_method: Training set labeled by 17 radiologists; test set labeled by consensus of senior radiologists.
annotation.labeling_provenance: Bounding-box and global labels derived from clinical radiology reports and expert review.
annotation.label_noise_description: Test set uses consensus labeling, limiting individual-rater variance; training set may contain inter-rater variability.
